legenda_completa: WE ARE OFFICIALLY DOWN TO JUST 13 DAYS UNTIL GTA 6 DROPS! ⏳🌴🔥🤯 Talk about a surreal, heart-pounding reality as the final countdown officially ticks down to just thirteen days away from the historic November 19, 2026 launch date! Every single year of waiting, every rumor, every trailer breakdown, and every piece of hype has led us right to this exact moment. The home stretch is moving at lightspeed, our setups are locked in, and our triumphant return to Vice City and the sprawling state of Leonida is practically breathing down our necks! 🚀✨😎 Are you ready for the final two-week sprint to launch day?
